name: console
description: Opt-in: state/console.json, the one machine-readable file a console or UI reads, and console_state.py, its only writer. Every value is a claim with provenance (resolved_by) and a confidence; unknown is first-class and never paints green. Reads kit-native state only (lock, Bosun heartbeat, status.json, queue, tickets, inbox, drops) and degrades to unknown/absent when a source is missing, so it works on either tier. The console itself lives in its own repo.
